optimization_objective: maximize class_logit[0]=glioma_tumor minus TV, FFT parameterization
image_parameterization: FFT spectral coefficients (real/imag), inverse FFT to RGB
input_initialization: small random FFT spectrum, NOT a real MRI
limitation: Synthetic visualization. Blur/abstraction is expected from FFT parameterization and MRI-domain shift. Do not interpret patterns as confirmed medical features. Hidden-neuron images are not class images.
